meta.title: Contact: WhatsApp, a 20-minute call or email
meta.description: Write to me on WhatsApp, book a 20-minute call, use the form or email. One route depending on whether you are a client, an agency or hiring.

head.citable: There are four ways to talk to me: WhatsApp, a 20-minute call, the form or email. Pick who you are and I will show you the most direct one.

client.title: For a website, an app or an idea
client.text: WhatsApp is the fastest. If you would rather see a price before writing, I can prepare a rough proposal in a minute.
client.leave: I would rather leave my details

partner.title: For agencies and consultancies
partner.text: A 20-minute call or a short message is enough to see whether I fit. You can also leave your details and I will write to you.

recruiter.title: For hiring
recruiter.text: Book a 20-minute call or write to me. The CV and a summary of my stack are in About.

other.title: For anything else
other.text: Tell me with the form. If you would rather ask first, the assistant can point you in the right direction.

quick.group: Quick ways to get in touch
quick.failed: Could not copy: select it by hand

form.name: Name
form.messageHelp: The more specific the better: what you want to do and by when.
